title: Panda Adventure items configuration
description: Authoritative config for the S7 Items & Equipment story (gADR-0000, gADR-0008): every item number in one source. The Consumable restore amounts (Bun -> HP, Wine -> MP; `wine_mp_restore` migrated here from gravity_config — gravity keeps only the MP sink), the consume-flash juice (per-item flash color + one shared duration, the hit-flash tween idiom), and the Spacesuit's protective value — the defense bonus composed onto the Player's defender stat block for the S2 damage formula's mitigation term (ItemSystem.effective_defender; the formula itself is untouched). Converted by scripts/build_config.py into the derived content/data/generated/items_config.tres (ItemsConfig).

rgba.description: A color as RGBA, each component in 0..1.

bun_hp_restore.description: HP restored by eating a Bun (capped at the stat block's max_hp at use time); strictly positive — a no-op Consumable is a config bug.

wine_mp_restore.description: MP restored by drinking a Wine (capped at the stat block's max_mp at use time); strictly positive. Migrated from gravity_config.json (the S3 Wine hook's home) so every Consumable effect reads from the one items authority (gADR-0008).

spacesuit_defense.description: The Spacesuit's defense bonus, added onto the Player's base defense to form the effective defender for the damage formula's mitigation term (gADR-0008). Non-negative like every stat-block defense; 0 is a legal (purely cosmetic) suit.

consume_flash_duration.description: Seconds the consume flash tween takes (shared by both Consumables). SUPERSEDED by the Player sprite animations (#443, gADR-0016) — consuming now plays the sprite's 'consume' one-shot; no longer read at runtime; retained for the editor schema forms (#441/#481). Strictly positive.
